metadata.description: Class 6 Career Discovery Assessment - 60 questions across 8 dimensions

dimensions.name: MI-Inspired Strength Domains
dimensions.scoring: 8 MI domains: Linguistic, Logical-Math, Spatial, Bodily-Kinesthetic, Musical, Interpersonal, Intrapersonal, Naturalistic

dimensions.name: Motivators & Values
dimensions.scoring: 5 motivator types: Achievement, Curiosity, Helping, Freedom, Leadership

dimensions.name: Learning Preferences
dimensions.scoring: 4 learning styles: Visual, Reading, Auditory, Kinesthetic

dimensions.name: Emotional & Social Awareness
dimensions.scoring: Developmental tendencies: Self-Awareness, Empathy, Social Management, Relationship Building

dimensions.name: Creativity & Future Readiness
dimensions.scoring: Future-readiness indicators: Problem-Solving, Adaptability, Innovation, Future Orientation
